payload.text: Doom/MELPA rename, ruled by hv (decision 52) and NOT yet executed: pin melpa to :branch "main" in Molt-matts' Doom config; Molt ships no change; rhadamanth-sysadm coordinates across the sleeves; molt-vc settles the how with it on hv's word (coordination message sent 9 Nov). Cause: MELPA renamed master to main and deleted master, and each sleeve's straight clone of melpa is single-branch with remote.origin.fetch hard-wired to master, so 'doom sync -u' fails at 'Updating recipe repos' with "fatal: couldn't find remote ref refs/heads/master"; editors_maintain (liberators/editors.sh:330-364) runs that command and molt_errors on it, which is Molt surfacing the fault, not hiding it. Finding that changes the fix: melpa is a straight recipe REPOSITORY, registered in Doom's own lisp/doom-packages.el straight-use-recipes block as (melpa :type git :host github :repo "melpa/melpa" :build nil) with no :branch, during straight's bootstrap and BEFORE $DOOMDIR/packages.el is read, so (package! melpa :recipe (:branch "main")) in packages.el is at best a no-op; the lever is straight-override-recipe ordered before that call, which in Doom means $DOOMDIR/cli.el. Doom here is 7ccac7f6; Molt-matts' config/doom/packages.el names no melpa. Not urgent: rhadamanth, kovacs and gyges are all on origin/main at 9a715f54 with molt maintain rc 0, so the pin only governs a future clone (a new sleeve, or farcaster and pihole when next reachable). Unverified and not asserted: whether straight repairs an existing single-branch clone once its recipe gains a :branch. Done when the pin is in Molt-matts and one 'doom sync -u' on one sleeve proves it.
